p1_cyber.title: select 5 OSS target projects with rich security-fix history; document selection criteria

layman_note.what: Selected 5 OSS projects (Django, curl, OpenSSL, Pillow, Node.js) across Python, C, and JavaScript.
layman_note.why: These projects have rich, documented security-fix histories â€” the raw material for building the answer key.
layman_note.concept: Git archaeology â€” mining commit history to find where vulnerabilities were introduced and fixed.

p1_cyber.title: answer-key miner v1: git archaeology of fix commits -> data/answer_key/django.json
p1_cyber.commit_sha_note: SHA derived from git log next run (commit includes this file)

layman_note.what: Built a reusable miner script and produced Django's answer key: 12 CVEs, 19 vulnerable file locations across 12 distinct CWE types.
layman_note.why: The answer key is ground truth â€” without known-correct answers, there's no way to measure how accurately the AI triages alerts.
layman_note.concept: Git archaeology via API â€” instead of cloning Django's 30k-commit repo, query GitHub's API for each fix commit's diff to find exactly which source files were patched.
layman_note.next: Mine curl's git history for >=10 pre-fix vulnerable spots (second answer-key entry).

layman_note.what: Mined 15 real CVEs from curl; 12 had code-level fixes, producing 24 vulnerable spots across 8 CWE types.
layman_note.why: curl is project 2 of 5. C memory bugs (UAF, double-free) are the classic triage-hard pattern.
layman_note.concept: Use-after-free (CWE-416): code accesses memory after it was freed. Classic C bug prevented by higher-level languages.
layman_note.next: Mine OpenSSL (project 3) for more C memory + crypto logic bugs.

p1_cyber.title: answer key: OpenSSL (project 3)
p1_cyber.commit_sha_note: SHA derived from git log post-push (commit includes this file)

layman_note.what: Mined 15 real CVEs from OpenSSL; produced 34 vulnerable source-file locations across 10 CWE types.
layman_note.why: OpenSSL is project 3 of 5. Crypto logic bugs + NULL derefs test different context-curve behaviors than Django/curl.
layman_note.concept: NULL pointer dereference (CWE-476): code tries to use a pointer that points to nothing; instant crash, often triggerable remotely.
layman_note.next: Mine Pillow and Node.js (projects 4 and 5) to complete the answer key.
